tests.title: Partial refund of one item from a paid multi-item order refunds its share of the discounts, points and stock
tests.goal: Refunding part of an order gives back the right money and takes back the right points and stock.
preconditions: A paid (receipt accepted) eShop order of a QA member with two different products and a basket discount (member level and/or promo code)
Points rule from Loyalty Setting > Point Policy
data: Refund to Original Payment Method (Bank Transfer); no card/wallet

steps.text: Note the order lines, discounts, total, member points, level spending and each product's Available in Inventory

Order detail > Exchange / Partial Return > Online Shop (POS in `iframe.webpos-iframe`): raise product 1's return qty, Next, cancel the Shipping popup, Exchange & refund, Bank Transfer (Actions > Refund this order is full-refund only)
Reread the original order, the linked refund order, the member Point History, level spending and Inventory

expected.text: Step 2: the item share = line price x paid total / subtotal (e.g. 600 of 1,600 on a 1,300 total = 487.50) and the refund equals it

Step 3: the original order line shows "Exchanged: 1" and a Status History "Exchange" row; a linked refund order ("This is an exchange order. Original order: ...") holds the returned line and the negative Bank Transfer payment
Step 3: points: the member keeps floor(10% x kept amount); level spending goes down by the refund once; product 1 Available +1, product 2 unchanged

notes: TXN0126102800001 -> refund 002: share 487.50, refund, points (-49) and stock right; level spending 1,042.00 instead of 1,529.50 (deducted twice). Reproduced on 004 and 005.

tests.title: Editing a paid order to a lower total records the difference as a refund and adjusts the points
tests.goal: When staff remove something from a paid order, the customer is not overcharged and points follow the new amount.
preconditions: A QA member's eShop order paid by Bank Transfer with the receipt accepted (Processing / Complete), placed during the test, two units of one product (or two products)
Order detail > Actions > Edit this order opens the Web POS and, on CHECK OUT, cancels the original and creates a replacement order "<number>A" (README; BUG-010)
Member points and level spending noted from My Account
data: Bank Transfer only; Cash only if the POS asks for a tender

steps.text: Note the original order total, Payment History and member points
Edit this order > Use order creation date, reduce one line by 1, Total, finish the POS flow
Open the replacement order and the original order in the CRM
Reread member points, level spending and Point History

expected.text: Step 2: the POS shows the amount already paid and the difference to give back (no negative "Balance due" without explanation)
Step 3: replacement order total = original minus the removed line (after discounts); paid status Complete; the difference appears as a refund line (or a clear outstanding credit)
Step 3: original order Canceled with a link to the replacement; payments are not counted twice in Payment History
Step 4: points and level spending reflect only the replacement total

notes: Paid 894.00 order edited to 510.00: POS asked for full 510 (Total Paid 0), 006A Pending Payment with 510 outstanding, 006 Canceled with no refund, points voided.

tests.title: Editing a paid order to a higher total leaves the extra amount outstanding until it is paid
tests.goal: Adding items to a paid order cannot mark the extra amount as paid by itself.
preconditions: A QA member's eShop order paid by Bank Transfer with the receipt accepted (Processing / Complete), placed during the test
Order detail > Actions > Edit this order opens the Web POS and, on CHECK OUT, cancels the original and creates a replacement order "<number>A" (README; BUG-010)

steps.text: Edit this order, raise a line quantity by 1 (or add a product), Total
Pay only what the POS asks as the balance with Bank Transfer, finish

expected.text: Step 1: the POS shows the amount already paid and Balance due = the added amount only
Step 3: Total = old total + added amount; Outstanding balance = added amount until a receipt for it is accepted; status not Complete before that
Step 3: the replacement keeps the original warehouse, shipping store, remark and product names (BUG-010)

notes: Paid 510.00 order edited to 894.00: Balance due 894 (not 384); 007A Pending Payment, 894 outstanding; eShop asks the customer for the full 894.

tests.title: Partial returns never refund more than the item share, and refunds on an order never exceed the amount paid
tests.goal: Rounding on a return cannot pay the customer more than they paid.
preconditions: A paid (receipt accepted) eShop order of a QA member with two items whose shares are not whole tenths, e.g. a HKD 600 item + a HKD 0.10 item with the member discount (total after rounding HKD 510.00), found at runtime

steps.text: Order detail > Exchange / Partial Return > Online Shop: select item 1, note its share, Next, read Rounding and Total
Finish the refund (Exchange & refund > Bank Transfer)
Add up the refund orders and compare with the order's paid total

expected.text: Step 1: refund = item 1 share, rounded toward zero (never more than the share)
Step 4: sum of refunds <= amount paid

notes: TXN0126102800003 paid 510.00: C share 509.92 refunded 510.00, cake share 0.08 refunded 0.10; 510.10 refunded in total.
